<style>

:root{
  --bg:#050508;
  --panel: rgba(16,20,38,0.22); /* TRANSPARENT */
  --panel-strong: rgba(16,20,38,0.38);
  --panel-ghost: rgba(16,20,38,0.12);
  --border:rgba(167,139,250,0.18);
  --border-2:rgba(167,139,250,0.42);
  --text:#f8fafc;
  --muted:#a8b0c0;
  --soft:#6b728f;
  --purple:#a78bfa;
  --pink:#ff4da0;
  --orange:#ff9f43;
  --cyan:#31e7ff;
  --lime:#9aff72;
  --gutter: clamp(16px, 3vw, 56px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);width:100%;max-width:100vw;overflow-x:clip}
body{font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; line-height:1.55; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img,svg,canvas,video{max-width:100%;display:block}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
.inline-link{color:#c4b5fd;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:rgba(196,181,253,.36);text-underline-offset:4px;font-weight:700}
.inline-link:hover,.inline-link:focus{color:#fff}
.svc-card[role="button"]{text-align:left;color:inherit;font:inherit;width:100%}
.svc-card:focus-visible,.faq-q:focus-visible,.modal-close:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:4px}
.form-glass .fluentform{position:relative;z-index:1}
.form-glass .ff-el-form-control{width:100%!important;padding:14px 16px!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)!important;color:#fff!important;font-family:inherit!important}
.form-glass .ff-el-form-control:focus{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,0.4)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.form-glass label{color:#f8fafc!important;font-weight:700!important}
.form-glass .ff-btn-submit{width:100%!important;justify-content:center!important;padding:14px 22px!important;border:0!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink))!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:800!important;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.3)!important}

/* Global Transparent Starfield - ENTIRE PAGE */
#globalStarfield{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  width:100vw;
  height:100vh;
  z-index:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  display:block;
  opacity:0.95;
}
.global-mesh{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.55}
.orb{position:absolute; border-radius:50%; filter:blur(90px); mix-blend:screen; will-change:transform}
.orb1{width:92vw; height:92vw; max-width:980px; max-height:980px; left:-12%; top:-16%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--purple), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, var(--pink), transparent 60%); animation:float1 18s ease-in-out infinite; opacity:0.32}
.orb2{width:74vw; height:74vw; max-width:860px; max-height:860px; right:-14%; top:18%; background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--cyan) 0%, transparent 65%); opacity:0.22}
.orb3{width:70vw; height:70vw; max-width:820px; max-height:820px; left:18%; bottom:-22%; background:radial-gradient(circle, var(--orange), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, var(--pink), transparent 55%); opacity:0.24}
@keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(3%,-4%) scale(1.08)}}
.grid-layer{position:absolute; inset:0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(167,139,250,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:72px 72px; mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, black 42%, transparent 86%); opacity:0.18}
.noise{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2; pointer-events:none; opacity:0.05; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
.scroll-progress{position:fixed; top:0; left:0; height:3px; width:100%; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left center; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple), var(--pink), var(--cyan)); z-index:9999}
.cursor-dot{position:fixed; width:6px; height:6px; background:#fff; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:9998; mix-blend:difference; opacity:0}
.cursor-ring{position:fixed; width:36px; height:36px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.42); border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:9997; mix-blend:difference; opacity:0}
@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){ .cursor-dot,.cursor-ring{opacity:1} }

.btn{position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 22px; border-radius:999px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:all .32s; white-space:nowrap}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.3)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(255,77,160,0.38)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(15,18,34,0.18); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--border-2); transform:translateY(-2px)}

main{position:relative; z-index:3; width:100%; max-width:100vw; overflow-x:clip}
.section{position:relative; width:100%; max-width:100vw; margin:0; padding: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 128px) var(--gutter); overflow-x:clip}
.section-label{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 13px; border-radius:999px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.08); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--purple); margin-bottom:18px; backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.dot{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--purple); box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--purple); animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:.5}}
.h2{font-size:clamp(30px, 4.2vw, 58px); line-height:0.96; margin:0 0 16px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.035em; max-width:20ch}
.h2 i{font-style:normal; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink) 32%, var(--orange) 66%, var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.p{font-size:clamp(14.5px, 1.12vw, 17.5px); line-height:1.72; color:var(--muted); max-width:66ch}
.marquee{position:relative; width:100vw; max-width:100vw; margin-left:calc(-1*var(--gutter)); margin-right:calc(-1*var(--gutter)); overflow:hidden; border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.015); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); padding:14px 0}
.marquee-track{display:flex; gap:38px; white-space:nowrap; animation:marquee 38s linear infinite}
.marquee-item{font-weight:800; font-size:17px; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px}
.marquee-item b{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72); -webkit-text-stroke:0}
.marquee-item .dot2{width:5px; height:5px; background:var(--pink); border-radius:50%; display:inline-block}
@keyframes marquee{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* HERO - different movement element */
.hero{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.12fr 0.88fr; gap: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 64px); align-items:center; padding-top: clamp(108px,9vw,168px); padding-bottom: clamp(40px,6vw,72px); min-height:86vh; overflow:visible}
.hero-pill{display:inline-flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.26); background:rgba(15,15,28,0.32); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:18px}
.hero-h1{font-size:clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 82px); line-height:0.9; margin:0 0 18px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.05em}
.hero-h1 .outline{color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1.35px rgba(255,255,255,0.30); display:block; font-weight:700}
.hero-h1 .grad{display:block; background:linear-gradient(105deg, var(--purple) 8%, var(--pink) 28%, var(--orange) 62%, var(--cyan) 92%); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; background-size:200% 200%; animation:gradMove 8s ease infinite}
@keyframes gradMove{0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(15px, 1.18vw, 18px); line-height:1.72; color:var(--muted); max-width:62ch; margin:0 0 26px}
.hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:18px}
.hero-stats{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:20px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{padding:13px 15px; border-radius:18px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); min-width:144px}
.stat-num{font-weight:800; font-size:22px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.stat-lab{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--soft); margin-top:2px}
.hero-visual{position:relative; width:100%; height:clamp(540px,54vw,760px); display:grid; place-items:center; perspective:1300px; overflow:visible; padding-block:clamp(28px,3vw,52px)}
.hero-scene{position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; display:grid; place-items:center; transform-style:preserve-3d; transform:translateY(clamp(12px,1.5vw,24px))}
.scene-rings{position:absolute; inset:0; display:grid; place-items:center; pointer-events:none}
.ring{position:absolute; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22); box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(167,139,250,0.06); will-change:transform}
.ring::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:-1px; border-radius:50%; padding:1px; background:conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--purple), var(--pink), var(--cyan), var(--orange), var(--purple)); -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite:xor; mask-composite:exclude; opacity:0.8}
.ring1{width:min(56vw,420px); height:min(56vw,420px); border-style:dashed; border-width:1px; animation:spin 24s linear infinite}
.ring2{width:min(72vw,560px); height:min(72vw,560px); animation:spin 36s linear infinite reverse; border-color:rgba(49,231,255,0.18)}
.ring3{width:min(86vw,680px); height:min(86vw,680px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); animation:spin 68s linear infinite; opacity:0.5}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.photon-core{position:relative; width:min(46vw, 280px); height:min(46vw, 280px); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 8%, var(--purple) 28%, var(--pink) 54%, var(--cyan) 82%); box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(167,139,250,0.5), 0 0 140px rgba(255,77,160,0.28), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); animation:photonPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; z-index:2}
@keyframes photonPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.photon-core::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:18%; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), transparent 58%); mix-blend:overlay}
.photon-halo{position:absolute; width:min(62vw, 420px); height:min(62vw, 420px); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,0.22), transparent 70%); filter:blur(20px); animation:halo 6s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events:none}
@keyframes halo{0%,100%{transform:scale(0.9); opacity:0.5}50%{transform:scale(1.15); opacity:0.8}}
.hero-fragments{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; transform-style:preserve-3d}
.frag{position:absolute; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(14,17,32,0.42); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.26); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:#e8e8ff; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); will-change:transform}
.frag svg{width:16px; height:16px; color:var(--purple)}
.frag1{top:12%; right:10%; animation:fFloat1 5.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag2{bottom:20%; right:4%; animation:fFloat2 6.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.frag3{top:54%; left:2%; animation:fFloat3 6.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fFloat1{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,30px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-12px,-16px,60px)}}
@keyframes fFloat2{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,20px)}50%{transform:translate3d(14px,-10px,50px)}}
@keyframes fFloat3{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,15px)}50%{transform:translate3d(-10px,12px,45px)}}
.hero-kinetic-lines{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.18}
.hero-kinetic-lines span{position:absolute; width:1px; height:120px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple), transparent); animation:lineFall linear infinite}
@keyframes lineFall{0%{transform:translateY(-140px)}100%{transform:translateY(780px)}}

/* Generic cards - all transparent now */
.answer-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr; gap:28px; padding: clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 42px); border-radius:30px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), rgba(49,231,255,0.04)), var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); backdrop-filter:blur(22px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px); width:100%}
.answer-side{display:grid; gap:12px; align-content:start}
.answer-chip{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:13px 15px; border-radius:16px; background:rgba(6,8,18,0.28); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.14); color:#e6e8f2; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.answer-chip svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2; fill:none}
.problem-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap: clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 24px)}
.p-card{padding: clamp(20px, 1.8vw, 28px); border-radius:26px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .4s, border-color .35s}
.p-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.p-card-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px}
.p-icon{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,77,160,0.14), rgba(167,139,250,0.14)); border:1px solid rgba(255,77,160,0.18); color:var(--pink)}
.p-num{font-size:36px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--purple)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.p-card h3{font-size:19px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.p-card p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.7; margin:0}
.proof-row{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:22px}
.proof-row span{padding:9px 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; font-weight:700}

/* SERVICES - fixed alignment to match other sections, still transparent */
.services-starfield{position:relative; width:100%; max-width:100vw; margin:0; padding: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 128px) var(--gutter); background:transparent; border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate}
.services-starfield .svc-content,
.services-starfield .h2,
.services-starfield .p{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; text-align:left}
.services-starfield .svc-hint{justify-content:flex-start}
.svc-content{position:relative; z-index:2; width:100%; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto}
.svc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 22px); margin-top:28px}
.svc-card{position:relative; padding: clamp(22px, 1.9vw, 28px); border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px); transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s, box-shadow .35s; cursor:pointer}
.svc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong); box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.12)}
.svc-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:var(--soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.svc-num::before{content:""; width:22px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.svc-card h4{font-size:19px; line-height:1.24; margin:12px 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.svc-card p{margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.8px; line-height:1.65}
.svc-line{width:28px; height:2px; background:var(--purple); margin-top:14px; transition:width .35s, background .35s}
.svc-card:hover .svc-line{width:48px; background:var(--pink)}
.svc-hint{margin-top:26px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; color:var(--soft); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em}
.svc-hint span{padding:8px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}

/* modal */
.service-modal{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; display:none; place-items:center; padding:20px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.52); backdrop-filter:blur(22px)}
.service-modal.active{display:grid}
.modal-box{width:100%; max-width:540px; border-radius:28px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22,24,48,0.92), rgba(12,14,28,0.96)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.28); padding:36px; position:relative; box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.modal-close{position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; cursor:pointer}
.modal-num{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.14em; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:var(--purple)}
.modal-box h3{font-size:30px; margin:14px 0 12px; font-weight:800}
.modal-box p{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; line-height:1.7}
.feat-list{display:grid; gap:10px; margin:18px 0 22px; padding:0}
.feat-list li{list-style:none; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:14px; font-weight:600}

/* tech */
.tech-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:16px; width:100%}
.t-card{padding:22px 18px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.t-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.t-logo{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.14), rgba(49,231,255,0.08)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.18); color:#c9bbff; margin-bottom:16px}
.t-logo svg{width:28px; height:28px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:1.8}
.t-card h3{font-size:16px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800}
.t-card p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin:0}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto; border-radius:22px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--panel); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.dec-table{width:100%; min-width:720px; border-collapse:collapse}
.dec-table th{padding:18px 20px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.08); text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.dec-table td{padding:18px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.6}
.dec-table td:first-child{color:#fff; font-weight:700; width:28%}

/* process */
.process-wrap{position:relative; width:100%}
.timeline-line{position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; bottom:0; width:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--purple) 10%, var(--pink) 50%, var(--cyan) 90%, transparent); transform:translateX(-50%); opacity:.4}
.proc-grid{display:grid; gap:26px; width:100%}
.proc-step{position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start; width:100%}
.proc-step:nth-child(even){direction:rtl}
.proc-step:nth-child(even) *{direction:ltr}
.proc-card{padding:24px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.proc-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-2); transform:translateY(-4px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.proc-num{width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:#fff}

/* why, readiness */
.split{display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 42px); width:100%}
.check-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:12px}
.check-item{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; padding:14px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid var(--border); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.check-item svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--purple); stroke-width:2.2; fill:none; margin-top:2px; flex-shrink:0}
.r-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.r-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.r-card h3{font-size:18px; margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:800}
.r-card p{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; margin:0}

/* RECENT WORK - 3 SECTIONS transparent */
.recent-work{display:grid; gap: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 36px); width:100%; margin-top:22px}
.work-section{display:grid; gap:18px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 32px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.work-section::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(167,139,250,0.08), transparent 42%); pointer-events:none}
.work-section-header{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-kicker{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--purple); display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center}
.work-kicker::before{content:""; width:18px; height:1px; background:var(--purple); display:inline-block}
.work-featured{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.15fr 0.85fr; gap:22px; align-items:start; position:relative; z-index:1}
.work-featured .w-img{position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/10; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(14,14,28,0.4); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.work-featured .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.work-featured:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.work-year{position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.62); border:1px solid rgba(255,159,67,0.26); color:var(--orange); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.work-body h3{font-size:28px; margin:0 0 8px; font-weight:800; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--orange), var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.work-body .w-sub{color:var(--soft); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase}
.work-body p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.66; margin:12px 0 16px}
.work-meta{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.work-meta span{padding:7px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600}
.work-grid-2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:18px; position:relative; z-index:1}
.w-card{border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(10,12,24,0.32); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; transition:transform .35s, border-color .35s, background .35s}
.w-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--border-2); background:rgba(10,12,24,0.48)}
.w-card .w-img{aspect-ratio:16/10; position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(16,16,30,0.4)}
.w-card .w-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .6s}
.w-card:hover .w-img img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.w-card .w-body{padding:18px}
.w-card .w-body h4{font-size:20px; margin:0 0 6px; font-weight:800}
.work-closing{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 0.9fr; gap:18px; align-items:stretch; position:relative; z-index:1}
.cta-panel{border-radius:22px; padding:26px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.12), rgba(255,77,160,0.12)); border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.22); display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* AMC */
.amc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.amc-card{position:relative; padding:28px; border-radius:24px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:all .35s}
.amc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); background:var(--panel-strong)}
.amc-num{font-size:64px; font-weight:900; line-height:1; opacity:0.12; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text}
.logos-wrap{margin-top:32px; padding:32px; border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); width:100%}
.logos-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap:18px; width:100%}
.logo-item{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:18px; padding:18px; transition:.3s}
.logo-item img{width:100%; max-width:112px; height:48px; object-fit:contain}
.logo-item span{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-align:center}

/* cost */
.cost-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; width:100%}
.cost-card{padding:26px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}

/* FAQ */
.faq-wrap{max-width:980px; margin:0 auto; width:100%}
.faq-list{display:grid; gap:14px}
.faq-item{border-radius:18px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); overflow:hidden; backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.faq-item.active{border-color:rgba(255,77,160,0.38); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.06)}
.faq-q{width:100%; text-align:left; background:transparent; border:0; color:#fff; padding:20px 22px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:16px; cursor:pointer; font-size:16px; font-weight:700}
.faq-icon{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:all .3s; font-size:18px}
.faq-item.active .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg); border-color:var(--pink); background:rgba(255,77,160,0.1)}
.faq-a{display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; transition:grid-template-rows .35s}
.faq-item.active .faq-a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.faq-a-inner{overflow:hidden}
.faq-a-inner p{padding:0 22px 22px; margin:0; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; font-size:14.5px}
.form-glass{margin-top:38px; padding: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 36px); border-radius:28px; background:var(--panel-ghost); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); width:100%}
.form-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; width:100%}
.input{width:100%; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:#fff; font-size:14px; outline:none}
.input:focus{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,0.4); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
textarea.input{grid-column:1/-1; min-height:120px; resize:vertical}

/* 4K */
@media (min-width: 1920px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(64px, 4.5vw, 120px); }
  .section{ padding: clamp(88px, 6vw, 160px) var(--gutter); }
  .h2{ font-size: clamp(44px, 3.2vw, 76px); }
  .hero-h1{ font-size: clamp(54px, 4.6vw, 104px) }
}
@media (min-width: 2560px){
  :root{ --gutter: clamp(96px, 5vw, 180px); }
  html{ font-size:17px }
  #globalStarfield{ opacity:1 }
}
@media (max-width: 1180px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:auto}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(96px,11vw,132px)}
  .hero-visual{height:clamp(580px,72vw,700px); order:-1; padding-block:36px}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .problem-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .r-grid,.cost-grid,.amc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .logos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proc-step{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .timeline-line{left:18px; transform:none}
  .work-featured, .work-grid-2, .work-closing{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .services-starfield{margin-left:0; margin-right:0; width:100%; max-width:100vw}
}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  :root{ --gutter: 18px }
  .section{padding:56px var(--gutter)}
  .hero{padding-top:clamp(88px,20vw,118px)}
  .hero-visual{height:460px; padding-block:34px; margin-bottom:8px}

<section class="section compact-section" id="development-process">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Development Process</div>
<h2 class="h2">A Clear Process from <i>Discovery to Launch and AMC</i></h2>
<p class="p">A structured process reduces avoidable revisions, keeps content and development aligned and makes technical responsibilities clear before launch.</p>
<div class="process-grid-new">
<article class="process-step-new"><span>01</span><h3>Discovery and objectives</h3><p>Business goals, audience, competitors, content, integrations, timelines and measurable conversion priorities.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>02</span><h3>Sitemap and search planning</h3><p>Page hierarchy, keyword intent, navigation, internal links, URL structure and content requirements.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>03</span><h3>UI/UX and content flow</h3><p>Responsive layouts, visual hierarchy, trust signals, calls to action and reusable component planning.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>04</span><h3>Development and integrations</h3><p>CMS or custom build, forms, APIs, analytics, technical SEO controls and reusable frontend components.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>05</span><h3>QA, migration and launch</h3><p>Device testing, performance checks, redirects, metadata, forms, analytics, indexing and launch validation.</p></article>
<article class="process-step-new"><span>06</span><h3>Measurement and AMC</h3><p>Post-launch monitoring, content updates, technical support, security, backups and improvement planning.</p></article>
</div>
</section>

<p class="p">Industry experience matters because page structure, trust signals, content depth, integrations and enquiry journeys vary by business model. Our approach adapts the technology and content architecture rather than forcing every project into the same template.</p>

<section class="section" id="amc">
<div class="section-label"><span class="dot"></span> Website Maintenance & AMC</div>
<h2 class="h2">Annual Maintenance Contracts for <i>Long-Term Website Stability</i></h2>
<p class="p">Website AMC keeps the live website monitored, updated, backed up and ready for ongoing business changes. The exact support plan is defined according to the platform, website size, update frequency and response requirements.</p>
<div class="amc-grid" style="margin-top:22px">
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">01</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Proactive Monitoring</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Scheduled uptime, form and performance checks with issue alerts and documented follow-up.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">02</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Security & Backups</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Security reviews, malware checks, backup management and recovery support according to the agreed plan.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">03</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Regular Updates</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">WordPress core, theme and plugin updates with compatibility checks and staged testing where applicable.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">04</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Performance Tuning</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Caching, image delivery, script review, database housekeeping and Core Web Vitals monitoring.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">05</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Content Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Planned updates to pages, banners, blogs, forms and campaign content within the AMC scope.</p></article>
<article class="amc-card"><div class="amc-num">06</div><h3 style="font-weight:800">Technical Support</h3><p class="p" style="font-size:14px">Issue resolution, change requests, integration assistance and technical guidance for the website team.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
